note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative (jurisdiction unspecified). Object A is a generic fictional object; no person is drawn and no state is shown as a harm caused by someone. The two states (prior condition / later change) and the levels are supplied placeholders on an illustrative scale, never real figures; nothing is measured, valued, attributed or decided, and no cause, fault, liability or outcome is stated. A and B are identical before the change beat; the one changed fact (where the stop is clamped) changes the geometry of the run (only B's mark spreads), never a winner or a conclusion. Omitted brief fields (coordinator decision BRIEF CUSTOMIZABLE FIELDS, 2026-10-05): none — events, causalLinks, alternatives and losses are editable, with the contrast fields (scenarioA, scenarioB, changedFact, sharedFacts, comparisonLabels); 'object' and 'levels' are added. Long-labels-stress: coordinator decision (standing stress-cap rule, docs/AUTHORING.md item 20, from LAW-0687/0689–0692: counts and field lengths capped to the longest values that fit every ratio; subject floor: 'Subject ≥ 0.20 of the frame height at rest and hold (causation-05 LAW-0700 decision)', production/SESSION_HANDOFF.md). True driver: the 1:1 box (each rig — panel, flag and floor — must reach 0.20 of the frame height, with A and B side by side at ≥ 0.40 of the frame width each or stacked). After trying the fallback layouts (side by side; stacked; stacked beside a right-hand text column, with the late chips under the lanes; head chips beside the rigs; a wider guide chip), the full stress did not fit 1:1. Measured, rendered at 1080p (2026-10-05; pre-cap copy saved in production/scratch/causation-07/LAW-0707.stress-precap.json): full counts and lengths (five entries, two accounts, one labelled link, two variation items, scenario labels of 37/33 and captions of 46/47 characters, guide 40, changed fact 101) → 1:1 fallback scale, 17 px, rig 0.098 of the frame height; 16:9 20 px / 0.229; 9:16 19–20 px / 0.15. Counts alone capped (four entries, no account, no link, one variation item) → 1:1 still on the fallback scale (0.116). The stress therefore caps the COUNTS at four entries, no account, no link note and one variation item (baseline 3 / 0 / 0 / 1) and the LENGTHS of the scenario labels and captions (27/23 and 27/28 characters), the guide (22), the first variation item (38) and the changed fact (84); the neutral note keeps its near-maximum length. After the cap: 1:1 17 px / 0.203 without scaling; 16:9 23 px / 0.364; 9:16 20 px / 0.210. Every text field stays strictly longer than the baseline and every count ≥ the baseline.
